description: PK surrogate — Driving: inspection_team_target, grain 1 đoàn thanh tra × 1 đối tượng
BK — mã lượt đoàn×đối tượng, unique per dòng
Mã vụ việc — mã đoàn thanh tra (hiển thị Mã vụ việc)
Tên đối tượng được thanh tra
Phân loại đối tượng — map 1:1 từ nguồn, không qua Classification Value
Loại hình — scheme TT_REVIEW_FORM_TYPE (PERIODIC/UNSCHEDULED → Định kỳ/Đột xuất)
etl_logic: inspection_team.form_tp_code INNER JOIN inspection_team ON inspection_team.inspection_team_id = inspection_team_target.inspection_team_id AND inspection_team.src_stm_code = 'THANHTRA_INSPECTION_TEAM'

description: Trạng thái — ETL-derived từ Inspection Team.Start_Date/End_Date: cả 2 NULL→Chưa thực hiện; Start NOT NULL AND End NULL→Đang thực hiện; cả 2 NOT NULL→Đã hoàn thành
etl_logic: CASE WHEN inspection_team.start_dt IS NULL AND inspection_team.end_dt IS NULL THEN 'NOT_STARTED' WHEN inspection_team.start_dt IS NOT NULL AND inspection_team.end_dt IS NULL THEN 'IN_PROGRESS' WHEN inspection_team.start_dt IS NOT NULL AND inspection_team.end_dt IS NOT NULL THEN 'COMPLETED' END INNER JOIN inspection_team ON inspection_team.inspection_team_id = inspection_team_target.inspection_team_id AND inspection_team.src_stm_code = 'THANHTRA_INSPECTION_TEAM'

description: Ngày ban hành quyết định thanh tra — date key
etl_logic: inspection_team.decision_dt INNER JOIN inspection_team ON inspection_team.inspection_team_id = inspection_team_target.inspection_team_id AND inspection_team.src_stm_code = 'THANHTRA_INSPECTION_TEAM'

description: Năm ban hành quyết định — slicer Year=selected_year
etl_logic: YEAR(inspection_team.decision_dt) INNER JOIN inspection_team ON inspection_team.inspection_team_id = inspection_team_target.inspection_team_id AND inspection_team.src_stm_code = 'THANHTRA_INSPECTION_TEAM'
